threshold_rule: max_norm_ratio = ceil(measured_norm * 1.5, 0.01) — fails when the leg's normalized wall grows 1.5x past its pin (machine speed normalized out by the in-process ref yardstick; slack absorbs run-to-run noise)

limiter.output/session: driver pump + backend callback machinery + Session plan.drive + fixture render + captured-output record — wall normalized to the in-bench mix64 yardstick; regresses on added per-callback cost in the callback path
limiter.input/typed-rt: driver pump + capture offer/drain + input_writer copy + typed process (GainNode) + output_reader observe — normalized likewise; regresses on added per-block cost in the capture/runtime path
